opening_message:
Ticket 1: Morgan Swanson (employee ID E037) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E037.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Morgan Swanson (E037) is a full-time Engineer requesting write access to Payroll. As a full-time employee, maximum access is write; role does not own Payroll, so admin is not available. Requested write is within policy. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - role: Engineer (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E037 is a contractor with basic security training (HR note lists full-time; security record takes precedence). Contractors with basic training max at read; write requires advanced training. Requested write exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: The security agent's record (stated as taking precedence over the HR note) shows E037 is a contractor with basic security training. Under policy, contractors without advanced security training max out at read; write is only permitted with advanced training. The requested write exceeds the maximum, so the maximum (read) is granted.

- Security agent says: contractor, basic security training, Engineer role, recommends read (contractors with basic training max at read; write requires advanced training)

The Security agent says "security record takes precedence" for employment type.

Access policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist role. Engineer does not own Payroll.

So if full_time: max write, requested write → grant write.
If contractor with basic training: max read, requested write → grant read.
